leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a custom Angular directive that implements debounce logic.
Initialize and manage a timer using RxJS operators within the directive.
Bind the directive to an input element to control event emission.
Configure the debounce duration via an input property.
Update the directive to emit a debounced value to a parent component.
Integrate the debounce directive into a component template to manipulate user input flow.
